Example 3
Decompose the following numerals using expanded form.
a. 640.078
b. Twenty-three and forty-two thousandths.
Solution (%]
a. 640.078 = 600 + 40 + 0.07 + 0.008 ~ —
b. 23,042 = 20 +3 + 0.04 + 0.002 Se
